action.description: Required for create: the response to run.

agentId.description: Owning agent. For create and store.

context.description: When it applies, free text. For create, store and patch.

idempotencyKey.description: Retry key: a resend returns the first result.

metadata.description: Free-form JSON. For create, store and patch.

scopeRef.description: Project, set on create/store (patch refuses it); filters list/recall.

sensitivity.description: Set on create/store only (patch refuses it). Default 'internal'.

statusFilter.description: For list: only strategies in this status.

supersedesId.description: Strategy this one replaces (it is closed). For create/store.

targetWorkspaceId.description: Write to this workspace UUID instead (needs write/admin; IDs: memory_context). op='create'/'store' only.

validAt.description: For list: only strategies valid at this instant.

validFrom.description: When it starts to apply. For create and store.

validTo.description: When it stops applying. For patch.
